name: Moeten
source:
Fan disc includes two mini scenarios:
1. "Betrayer ～Kaori～" is about Kirishima story that takes place prior to original game
2. "Dog Life ～Fuyuha～" is a fan-service story about betrayal

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
资料片收录两个迷你故事：
1．《Betrayer～香织～》讲述雾岛在原作故事发生前的经历。
2．《Dog Life～冬叶～》是一篇以背叛为题材的玩家福利故事。
